/effect.reason: The catalog effect is community-authored Ability DSL; MFM supplies neither a durable DSL encoding nor a source for its mechanics.

/game_version.reason: The repository assigns catalog-version applicability; the MFM snapshot version is not an entity game-version value.

/game_version/dataslate.reason: Dataslate labels are repository-authored catalog applicability, not an MFM keyword attribute.

/game_version/edition.reason: Edition labels are repository-authored catalog applicability, not an MFM keyword attribute.

transforms.operation: Candidate normalization of a display name to the repository entity-id format.

/id.reason: No current MFM path seeds the universal unit-keyword catalog, so an MFM display name is evidence only and is not asserted to equal a stable catalog id.

transforms.operation: Resolve localized keyword names through miniature assignments, preserving source display order while deduplicating.

filters: Retain keyword rows assigned to a miniature of the current datasheet.
Discard missing localized names and duplicate display names.
precedence: Miniature display order, then miniature-keyword display order; the first occurrence of a name wins.
/name.reason: MFM supplies vocabulary and per-miniature assignment evidence that seed-units currently materializes on unit records; it does not seed universal unit-keyword catalog records.

/overridable_parameters.reason: MFM records the keyword label only and has no notion of a parameter that carries a default and may be overridden by a variant. The distinction is repository knowledge read out of the printed rule: Deep Strike's distance defaults to 8" and six factions ship a variant that overrides it.

/overridable_parameters/*.reason: One entry per overridable parameter; no MFM attribute corresponds to it.

/overridable_parameters/*/default.reason: The default comes from the printed rule text, which MFM does not carry as structured data.

/overridable_parameters/*/name.reason: Parameter name is repository vocabulary, not an MFM field.

/overridable_parameters/*/unit.reason: Unit of measure is repository vocabulary, not an MFM field.

/required_parameters.reason: Required parameter keys are a repository-authored catalog contract; MFM keyword rows do not encode this normalized requirement.

/required_parameters/*.reason: Each parameter key is authored as part of the repository catalog contract.

unmapped_mfm_fields.reason: The MFM keyword identifier is an internal source key, not a verified stable unit-keyword catalog slug.
